        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if any(c!=0 for c in r)]
    # find gap rows between contiguous shape row-bands
    bands=[]; start=rows[0]; prev=rows[0]
    for r in rows[1:]:
        if r==prev+1: prev=r
        else: bands.append((start,prev)); start=r; prev=r
    bands.append((start,prev))
    if len(bands)==2:
        for r in range(bands[0][1]+1, bands[1][0]):
            g[r]=[3]*len(g[r])
    return g
